toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":6,"perceivedCorrectness":75,"actionability":6,"reason":"The brief is convincing because the yield drop is concentrated in the tiers whose awards were cut, and early-action admits, who were decided on time on the old system, fell almost as much as regular-decision admits; the catch is that the cut tiers are also the files that went through the delayed merit-review step, and without a split by round that overlap isn't fully resolved."}

output.reason: The brief is convincing because the yield drop is concentrated in the tiers whose awards were cut, and early-action admits, who were decided on time on the old system, fell almost as much as regular-decision admits; the catch is that the cut tiers are also the files that went through the delayed merit-review step, and without a split by round that overlap isn't fully resolved.
